title: CardCorpus prices of many sets
description: The newest `price` and 30-day change of every copy in 1 to 64 sets, for sorting a list or valuing a collection in few requests. Served by index.json's `prices.sets`, not in this tree; 400 for no set or more than 64 (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#prices).

tcgplayer.description: TCGplayer's newest day here, or null before it has one.

day.description: The day its prices are for.

updated.description: When TCGplayer says it made them.

cardmarket.description: Cardmarket's newest day here, or null before it has one.

day.description: The day its prices are for.

createdAt.description: When Cardmarket says it made them.

sets.description: Every set asked for, by its id; empty when nothing in it is priced.

additionalProperties.description: The set's cards that have a price, by card id.
The card's copies that have a price, by copy id.
A copy's price on each marketplace and how it moved.

price.description: The market price, in US dollars.
The trend or an average, in euros.

change30d.description: How the copy's price moved over 30 days on each marketplace, as a fraction: 0.045 is up 4.5%, 0 is less than 2% either way. A marketplace is left out when there is too little to compare.
